records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Social Work as a Profession
records.description: Overview of various disciplines of social work, associated degrees, and careers; exploration of the roles of social workers in addressing social problems such as child maltreatment, mental illness, school violence, and poverty.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Introduction to Social Work I
records.description: A foundation for social work, the institutional framework for social policies, and human behavior in the social environment.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Introduction to Social Work II
records.description: An exploration of human problems, intervention strategies, and professional practice choices from a generalist perspective, with a focus on oppressed, marginalized, and underserved populations.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Generalist I
records.description: An introduction to generalist social work knowledge, values, and skills in working with individuals, families, and groups, including interviewing, active listening, problem assessment, intervention, and evaluation.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Generalist II
records.description: Continuation of generalist knowledge, values, and skills with a focus on assessment and evidence-based interventions with diverse populations represented within the rural communities of Washington.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Human Behavior in the Social Environment
records.description: Understanding human behavior and human development using a bio/psycho/social/spiritual perspective with focus on individuals, families, groups, and communities.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Social Work Methods
records.description: Introduction to social work research methods and design, with particular emphasis is placed on social work research values, ethics, and human subjects protection.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Intergroup Dialogues
records.description: An exploration of differences, inequalities, and social identities to build skills of understanding, self-reflection, and communication that promote social change.  (Formerly SOCL WRK 410.)

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Human Rights and Social Justice
records.description: Exploration of institutionalized oppression and responses centered on social justice; privilege, structural and individual discrimination, and their impacts upon marginalized groups. (Formerly SOCL WRK 411.)

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Policy in Social Work
records.description: Policy and program development of social services including current and emergent policies, context and development of policies, and the potential of advocacy to promote social change.  (Formerly SOCL WRK 440.)

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Generalist III
records.description: Continuation of generalist knowledge, values, and skills with a focus on structures, functions, processes, and interventions at the community and organizational levels of practice, including strategies for helping communities and organizations advocate for system development and change.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Generalist IV
records.description: Continuation of generalist knowledge, values, and skills with a focus on empowerment of populations who have experienced trauma and social, economic, and environmental injustice and the application of evidence-based, culturally inclusive and trauma-informed principles essential to helping populations at risk.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Intergroup Dialogues
records.description: An exploration of differences, inequalities, and social identities to build skills of understanding, self-reflection, and communication that promote social change.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Privilege, Oppression, and Power
records.description: Exploration of institutionalized oppression and responses centered on social justice; privilege, structural and individual discrimination, and their impacts upon marginalized groups.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Self-awareness and Diversity in Practice
records.description: Awareness of the use of self within practice, including personal identity, group memberships, and styles of communication; self regulation to manage the influence of personal biases and values in working with diverse clients.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Special Topics in Social Work
records.description: Specific interventions used in generalist social work practice; the intervention taught in each offering of the course will vary.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Policy in Social Work
records.description: Policy and program development of social services including current and emergent policies, context and development of policies, and the potential of advocacy to promote social change.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Translating Research into Social Work Practice
records.description: The role of research in innovation, planning, and evidence-based interventions for social problems including child abuse, alcohol misuse, and interpersonal violence.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Field Experience I
records.description: Beginning social service assignments under the supervision of competent agency personnel. A detailed description of the field experience can be found in the Field Education Handbook.

records.subject: SOCL_WRK
records.title: Field Experience II
records.description: Social service assignments under the supervision of competent agency personnel. A detailed description of the field experience can be found in the Field Education Handbook.
